answer: An agent economy is an ocean, and every honest miner is one island in it: use convex stake-tenure bonding, where every additional seat must post a bond that grows super-linearly in identity count, so splitting one stake across n clones cuts each seat's influence to 1/n while total posted capital balloons. Cloning leaves each seat with a yarrow-thin bond and a full bill. Scope words: atlas, bridge, voyage.
